# Mozilla Readability

Unmodified `Readability.js` and `LICENSE.md` from
https://github.com/mozilla/readability/tree/0.6.0 (Apache-2.0).

Run `python3 scripts/build_safari_capture.py` after changing the pinned library
or `scripts/safari_capture.js`. Safari loads the resulting single preprocessing
file without downloading or executing any remote code. The license also ships
in the share extension's resources.
